description: This file defines an abstract class 'VersionedGestureDetector' and its subclasses for handling gesture detection across different Android SDK versions, including touch and scale gestures.

classes.name: VersionedGestureDetector
classes.description: Abstract class for gesture detection with version-specific implementations.

classes.name: CupcakeDetector
classes.description: Handles gesture detection for Android versions before Eclair.

classes.name: EclairDetector
classes.description: Handles gesture detection for Android versions from Eclair to Froyo, managing multiple pointers.

classes.name: FroyoDetector
classes.description: Extends EclairDetector to include scale gesture detection for Froyo and above.

methods.name: VersionedGestureDetector.newInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the appropriate detector based on SDK version.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to handle touch events.
